The Confederations Cup final matches are the last of the competition, and the results determine which country's team is declared champions. The tournament was won by 2002 FIFA World Cup winners Brazil, who defeated Argentina 4–1 in the final at the Waldstadion in Frankfurt.  The final was a rematch of the Copa América final also won by Brazil.  It was Brazil's second win at the Confederations Cup.

Players marked (c) were named as captain for their national team.
